concepts.name: 01-folded-paper-h
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate a polished logo exploration for Hermit, a friendly business-paperwork roadmap app. One logo only, not a presentation board or multiple variants. Horizontal lockup: distinctive icon on left, exact wordmark 'Hermit' on right in confident clean rounded sans-serif, dark navy #111827. Flat vector-style graphics with crisp clean edges, blue #2463D4 primary icon color and optional light-blue #7FB7E4 accent. Genuine transparent alpha background. Centered composition on a square canvas, generous transparent margins. Professional simple memorable identity, legible at small sizes. No tagline, no extra text or numbering, no mockup surface, no background shape, no photographic effects, no shadows, no 3D, no gradients, no thin fiddly detail, no government insignia. Icon concept: FOLDED PAPER H. A compact geometric paper/document silhouette with a folded top-right corner, using a deliberate negative-space cutout and fold geometry to clearly form a capital H. Balance the paper association and a highly recognizable H; the fold is the only light-blue accent. A graphic brand mark rather than a stock document outline.
